Services

Work with me

One-to-one therapy and coaching, consultation for professionals, and talks for your group. Each one is grounded in Polyvagal Theory, without psychobabble or woo-woo.

Therapy

One-on-one, couples, or family therapy with me, a Licensed Marriage and Family Therapist specializing in trauma. California residents only. Insurance not accepted.

$150 a session
Coaching

One-on-one sessions to build your own unstucking plan: your concerns, what you've tried, your sense of safety, where you're stuck, your goals, and your next steps. Zero pressure.

$150 a session
Professional consultation

For therapists and practitioners who want to apply Polyvagal Theory to specific clients. Bring a case, leave with a direction.

$200 a session
Speaking

Talks, workshops, and trainings for organizations, conferences, and teams, tailored to your audience.

By request
Learn and practice with me

The Unstucking Academy

Self-paced learning on the Unstucking Pathway, or everything, with people: live practice, cohorts, and community. Both tiers include the Stuck Not Broken app.
